fields.name: dst
fields.note: byte+3 DESTINATION register descriptor (low). Proven: with source (+4) and lane (+6) held constant across two shuffles of the same value writing distinct dsts, +3 moved (0x00 vs 0x04); matches the 10-byte 0x56 int-ALU (iadd2) sibling whose dst is also byte+3.

fields.name: src
fields.note: byte+4 SOURCE register descriptor; tracks the source register (0x02->0x03 when the shuffled value is kept live).

fields.name: srctype
fields.note: byte+5 source operand data-type/width bits: 0x00=32-bit, 0x04=16-bit (own-MSL u32 vs half diff). values partial / needs-splice.

fields.name: lane
fields.note: byte+6 lane index / xor mask, encoded (index<<1). HW-VALIDATED (EXP-0018).

fields.name: rtype
fields.note: byte+7 result type/width marker in the shuffle/bcast/xor/updown forms: 0x2c=32-bit, 0x20=16-bit. In the rotate/fill form (mode 0x06) this byte + dsthi + rsv9 instead carry the fill/delta operand. values partial / needs-splice.

fields.name: dsthi
fields.note: byte+8 DESTINATION register descriptor (high) in the primary forms; co-varies with the dst register (0x02<->0x04) while width is constant. Repurposed as a fill/delta operand in the mode-0x06 rotate form.

fields.name: rsv9
fields.note: byte+9 reserved (0x00) in the shuffle/bcast/xor/updown forms; carries the rotate/fill tail (e.g. 0xa2) in the mode-0x06 form.

descriptors.semantics: d = src from another lane. byte0 0x47=broadcast/shuffle-up/fill_up, 0xc7=shuffle-xor/shuffle-down/fill_down (bit7=direction). byte+1 mode: 0x04 SIMD, 0x00 quad, 0x05 simd_updown (up=0x47/down=0xc7), 0x06 rotate/shuffle_and_fill. byte+3=dst reg, byte+4=src reg, byte+5=source width/type, byte+6=lane index/xor mask (index<<1), byte+7=result-type marker (0x2c 32b / 0x20 16b), byte+8=dst reg high. R8 typed the former b3/b5/tail raw region.
descriptors.provenance: HW-VALIDATED role (EXP-0018 + RT-ISA-FIX). R8 (EXP-M4-13, own-MSL byte-diff, no GPU dispatch): dst(+3) isolated by a src-and-lane-constant / dst-varying pair (sh_two: 47 04 56 04 03.. vs 47 04 54 00 03..) and cross-checked against the iadd2 10B-0x56 sibling (dst=byte+3); src(+4) tracked the source register (0x02->0x03 keep-alive); srctype(+5)/rtype(+7) shifted together on the u32->half width toggle (00->04, 2c->20); dsthi(+8) co-varied with dst reg (02<->04) under constant width; the mode-0x06 rotate form's tail (00 14 a2) tokenizes clean. Reg-number bit-split and the width/marker value maps are byte-diff-inferred, not splice-dispatch-validated.

descriptors.semantics: RAY-TRACING ray-vs-node coordinate-transform / AABB slab-test companion op executed inside the (software) BVH traversal loop, distinct from the dedicated rt_intersect primitive. byte0 low-nibble 0x2 (hi nibble=result reg); byte+2/+3/+4 = fixed sub-opcode 0x27 0x81 0x22; byte+8 = fixed 0x20 marker. Operands: byte+1 primary source, and a swapping register PAIR at byte+5 (opA) / byte+9 (opB). ~4-5 per intersector / ray-query kernel. R8 typed the former marker/b3/cmpmode/body raw region. (The per-lane transform/slab-test arithmetic sequence itself is intentionally NOT reconstructed -- clean-room rule 5.)
